sar.narrative: This report concerns suspected fraud following an undocumented coordinated pattern on card C01727-K2 held by customer C01727 (internal case AC-HHF-006, opened 2017-01-28). Between 2017-01-17 and 2017-01-28 the card was used for 3 transaction(s) totalling $967.68: on 2017-01-17 $305.41 online in billing region 231.0; on 2017-01-18 $366.35 online in billing region 231.0; on 2017-01-28 $295.92 online in billing region 231.0. The activity matches a coordinated undocumented wave across 17 cards sharing the signature (R_emaildomain = 'sc.rr.com' on online ProductCD='C' transactions across 17 cards). The other connected cards in this wave are C00534-K2, C01357-K1, C01507-K1, C01594-K1, C02167-K2, C03060-K1, C04146-K1, C04668-K1, C05610-K1, C06115-K1, C06639-K1, C08384-K1, C10350-K1, C11617-K1, C11743-K2, C11940-K1. The activity was identified from the bank's graph of shared devices and prior cases rather than from a customer report. The activity is inconsistent with the cardholder's history (prior median purchase $107.86). 3 prior report(s) were filed on this customer (CC-1501, CC-1833, CC-1975). OFAC SDN screening of the customer identifier: no match (anonymised identifiers; screening result recorded from the sdn.csv lookup in the live run). Recommended actions: a block and reissue of the card, not yet done and awaiting team-lead approval, internal case opened, 16 connected cards placed under monitoring, case escalated to an analyst.
